findings.evidence: PolynomialMemLp.lean:20-24 states the layer is deliberately measure-independent ("no dependence on the particular measure, so they apply verbatim to the Gaussian measure ... and to the compactly supported Chebyshev measure alike"); `grep -rn "→ₗ[ℝ] Lp" TauCeti/` hits only Span.lean:46, so no general map exists yet.
findings.fix: Define `polynomialEvalLp {μ : Measure ℝ} (hmom : ∀ k, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ k) μ) : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ` with its `coeFn` lemma in TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Function/PolynomialMemLp.lean, and set `polynomialEvalChebyshevLp := polynomialEvalLp integrable_pow_measureT` (or drop the abbreviation entirely). Chebyshev-specific content then begins at polynomialEvalChebyshevLp_T.
findings.issue: polynomialEvalChebyshevLp (and coeFn_polynomialEvalChebyshevLp, line 59) are fixed to Polynomial.Chebyshev.measureT, but their construction and proofs use only `memLp_two_eval_measureT`, which is itself `memLp_two_eval_of_forall_integrable_pow integrable_pow_measureT` (Moments.lean:52). The Gaussian side already instantiates the same generic lemma (Gaussian/PolynomialMemLp.lean:57) and Part A/B1 needs the identical map, so this will be duplicated verbatim.

summary: The evaluation-into-L² linear map and its coeFn lemma are stated only for measureT, although their proofs use nothing beyond the finite-moment hypothesis that the repo already isolates family-agnostically; the Chebyshev-specific content starts only at polynomialEvalChebyshevLp_T. Everything else sits at the natural level.
